findings.text: Fully dark frame for >= 1.95 s (from no later than L5240, sheet 0287 slot 8, to at least L5357; U appears by L5400) between 07_5 and 07_6. Stills cannot tell whether narration continues over the dark screen; root may want to check it against the cue timeline.

Card 'holomorphic on U: ... of the open region U' sets U upright in the text face, while the figure labels the region with italic math U; same card through sheet 0290 (L6000-6455). Cosmetic; meaning is clear.

Heading 'A closed square, with a little room beyond' (with 'f holomorphic on a neighborhood' and the contour-integral formula) is on screen from L3784 for 10.1 s before any square is drawn (first drawing L4392, sheet 0310 slot 5); the left two-thirds of the frame is measured empty (max deviation 0) in all 85 sampled stills in between (sheet 0299 slot 8 to sheet 0310 slot 4; sheet 0310 itself is read in the next batch). A viewer reads 'a closed square' with no square visible. Stills cannot tell what the narration says over this hold.

The square's orientation arrows sit just inside its outline; the right-edge and bottom-edge arrowheads overlap the outline in the same yellow (crop crops/s0311-slot1-right-edge-arrow.png), so the heads fuse with the edge. Direction remains readable from the shafts; cosmetic.

Heading 'A closed square, with a little room beyond' and 'f holomorphic on a neighborhood': no neighbourhood margin ('room beyond') is drawn around the square in any still from L4392 to L5296 (sheets 0310-0325). Whether the narration or a later picture covers it is outside these stills.

In '|I_{n+1}| >= |I_n|/4' the >= sign is much heavier and sans-looking than the thin Computer Modern strokes around it ('=', '+', bars, slash), so it reads as a glyph from another face (crop crops/s0337-slot8-geq-formula.png). Same class as the heavy not-equal sign noted in an earlier review of this film. Meaning is clear.

The proof-by-contradiction assumption appears as a bare green '|I_0| > 0' that replaces '∮ f dz = 0' in the same spot; nothing on screen marks it as a supposition. A reader of the stills alone could take it as a stated fact contradicting the theorem. Whether the narration says 'suppose' cannot be told from stills.

The green 'c' that names the limit point is placed about 64 tile px right of the green dot, outside the level-2 and level-3 squares and across two of their yellow edges, with no leader line (crop crops/s0357-slot4-c-label.png). It reads as labelling the empty part of the top-right quarter rather than the point inside the nest. No stroke crosses the glyph (the earlier layout flag no longer shows).
Extends L4: the <= in the grey triangle-inequality footnote has the same heavy, sans-looking strokes as the >= (crop crops/s0343-slot1-triangle-footnote.png).

In 'f(z) = f(c) + f'(c)(z - c) + r(z)' the minus sign is a short, heavy dash, about half as wide as the '+' bars and thicker than them (crop crops/s0367-slot3-taylor-formula.png). It reads more like a hyphen than a maths minus; same look as the heavy >= and <= of L4. Meaning stays clear.

The grey caption 'Exact changes, added tip to tail' stays word-for-word the same across the swap from the teal f(c) picture to the green f'(c)(z - c) picture, yet it fades out with the teal group and back in with the green: max deviation 132 at L8289, 13 at L8313 (effectively invisible), 130 again by L8340 (crop crops/s0380-slot4-caption-dip.png). In motion this should read as a blink of a label that did not change, over about 0.5 s; stills can't confirm how it reads in motion.

In the green 'exact changes' chain the third step (down-right) runs parallel to, and within about 4 tile px of, the long fourth step that returns to the start, so the held picture shows one doubled stroke with a head at each end instead of two arrows (crop crops/s0383-slot1-green-chain.png). The build order is visible while the arrows are drawn (L8367-8404, sheet 0381), but in the held state the closed four-step loop reads as three strokes. The mathematics (zero sum) is unaffected.

After the right column clears at L7552, only the Taylor line and the nest are on screen; the right two-thirds stays empty until the teal f(c) term arrives at L7985 (about 7.2 s; last empty sample L7962, sheet 0374 slot 5). The new line is on screen and matches the picture, so this is a composition note rather than a defect; what the narration does over the hold cannot be told from stills.

The ∂ in the subscript of 'I_n = ∮_{∂Q_n} r(z) dz' is an upright, heavy, sans-looking glyph next to the thin italic Computer Modern Q_n (crop crops/s0393-slot1-In-epsilon.png); it reads as a glyph from another face, same class as L4/L6. The <= in '|r(z)| <= ε|z - c|' (from L9144) is the same heavy glyph as L4 (crop crops/s0395-slot1-r-bound.png). Meaning is clear.

The text line reads 'Choose any epsilon > 0' with the Greek letter spelled out as a word, while the formula placed directly under it from L9144 uses the symbol: '|r(z)| <= ε|z - c|'. The screen therefore names the same quantity two ways; a reader has to connect 'epsilon' with ε. Writing 'Choose any ε > 0' would match.

After the δ-circle and the two bounds finish fading in (L9156), the picture does not change until the outer square starts to dim at L9772: a static hold of about 10.2 s. Every element on screen is relevant, so this is a pacing note only; what the narration does over the hold cannot be told from stills.

In the 'Selected square, magnified' view the δ-circle is not drawn, while '|z - c| < δ' stays in the text column. Mathematically the magnified square lies inside the disk, so the circle would fall outside the view; nothing on screen says so. A reader may need the narration to connect the two.

In the magnified square the green z-c segment, with z at the bottom-left corner, is drawn over the whole lower half of the teal diagonal, so the visible teal runs only from c to the top-right corner and the 'D_n' label sits beside that half (crop crops/s0434-slot1-Dn-Pn-labels.png). The picture therefore reads as D_n = distance from c to a corner = the green |z - c|, i.e. half the true diagonal. The bound |z - c| <= D_n used by the proof is still true (it is not tight), but the picture suggests equality and a halved D_n. The new 'P_n' (from L10339) is centred under the bottom side, where it reads as that side's length rather than the perimeter of Q_n. Whether later text defines P_n is checked on the following sheets.

Under 'Two halves make one quarter' the next square is drawn concentric with the magnified square, centred on c, at half the side (crop crops/s0445-slot1-inner-square.png). In the bisection the proof uses, Q_{n+1} is one of the four quarters of Q_n and shares a corner with it; no quarter of Q_n is concentric with it. The sizes are right (half the diagonal, half the perimeter, so D_n P_n falls by 4, matching the formulas), but the picture shows a square the construction never produces, and the '|I_{n+1}| >= |I_n|/4' line added at L11141 refers to a chosen quarter that is not drawn. Drawing one quarter (the one containing c) would match.

After 'Two halves make one quarter' the old column fades and '|I_0| <= 4^n|I_n|' stands alone on the right from L11418 to L11831 (about 6.9 s), then '|I_n| <= ε D_0 P_0/4^n' joins it and the picture is again static from L11856 to L12282 (about 7.1 s). The left figure does not change over either hold. Each line is correct and relevant; this is a pacing note only, and what the narration does over the holds cannot be told from stills.
